description: from($x) projects $x before it extends to the end. $x captures only the synthetic T restored between A and B, so it projects to the empty span at 1, and text(from($x)) is "b". Over the reconstructed tokens, from($x) starts at the synthetic's source point, the end of "a", and its text is " b": a is lost and c alone would pass. The text between the two original tokens is what the case observes (engine §7.4, §7.5).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A $x(gap) B
%conditions text(from($x)) = "b"
%rule gap [T]
%rule b A [T] [T] B
%rule c A T B
